newsitem.title: CANADA: Interfor wins court order against blockade.
newsitem.headline: Interfor wins court order against blockade.

text.p: A British Columbia court on Wednesday granted International Forest Products Ltd an injunction barring a blockade of its logging operations on King Island, the environmental group Greenpeace said.
The British Columbia Supreme Court issued an injunction against the blockade and an enforcement order that empowered police to arrest protesters, Greenpeace spokeswoman Tzeporah Berman said.
About 60 environmental protestors had halted logging operations on the island since last Friday by blockading the main access road.
Greenpeace group expected police to begin making arrests quickly but many protestors are determined to remain there as long as possible, she said.
